We should call the function twice for weight (neutron, proton) and twice for diameter (neutron, proton). Or we can combine? The function signature expects one particle at a time. So we need separate calls.

We need to output the results. The user wants both masses and diameters. We'll call the function for neutron weight, then proton weight, then neutron diameter, then proton diameter. Then format answer.
